_comment: Swiggy Builders Club MCP servers. Remote, streamable-HTTP, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE (issuer https://mcp.swiggy.com/auth, dynamic client registration supported). Requires Builders Club access (apply at https://mcp.swiggy.com/builders). After adding, run /mcp in Claude Code (or restart Claude Desktop) to trigger the OAuth login flow per server. Access tokens last ~5 days; refresh_token grant is advertised.
